decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (W1, W2 and Unnumbered Location Plan [received on 6 February 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  walls of the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be in keeping with the main house.
Condition : 5 - The premises shall be used for storage ancillary to the use of main building at 114 Hounslow Road, Hanworth and for no other purpose.
description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding for use as storage to the rear of the building
